title: Promotions Rule: Annual Spend Bonus on Residential Electricity Supply Loyalty Credits
content:
Promotions rule, Residential Electricity Supply renewal loyalty credits.

**Rule.** The net amount of all of the agreement's bill lines posted less than twelve whole months before the posting date is taken, charges counted positive and every credit and rebill credit counted negative. At 1,250 USD or more the high spend bonus of 25.00 USD is added; from 1,000 up to but not including 1,250 USD the mid spend bonus of 10.00 USD is added; below 1,000 USD nothing is added.

**What enters the net amount.** Every Beacon Ridge bill line on the agreement posted inside the window: energy charges, monthly service fees and early termination fees count positive; sign-up, online, referral, dual-fuel and renewal loyalty credits and rebill credits count negative. A line counts when fewer than 12 whole months separate its posting date from the posting date of the loyalty credit.

| Net amount of lines posted in the window | Spend bonus |
|---|---|
| 1,250 USD or more | 25.00 USD |
| 1,000 USD up to but not including 1,250 USD | 10.00 USD |
| below 1,000 USD | nothing |

**Worked net amount (hypothetical).** Charges of 1,312.40 USD and credits of 75.00 USD in the window net to 1,237.40 USD, which earns 10.00 USD. Exactly 1,250.00 USD would earn 25.00 USD; 999.99 USD would earn nothing.
